stories.title: Eski DHMİ Daire Başkanı Mehmet Cemil Acar gözaltına alındı

en.title: Former DHMI Department Head Mehmet Cemil Acar Detained
en.summary: Mehmet Cemil Acar, a former official at Turkey's State Airports Authority, was taken into custody. He denies accusations in his ongoing trial and claims an expert report has not been submitted to the case file for months.

stories.title: Başsavcılık duyurdu: DHMİ eski yöneticisi Mehmet Cemil Acar gözaltına alındı

en.title: Prosecutor's Office Announces: Former DHMI Administrator Mehmet Cemil Acar Detained
en.summary: Mehmet Cemil Acar, a former State Airports Authority administrator, was detained as part of a money laundering investigation launched by Ankara's chief prosecutor's office.

stories.title: Son Dakika... Evinde külçe külçe altın bulunan eski DHMİ Daire Başkanı Mehmet Cemil Acar tahliye edilmişti: Yeniden gözaltına alındı

en.title: Breaking News... Former DHMI Department Head Mehmet Cemil Acar, Who Had Bars of Gold Found in His Home, Was Released: Detained Again
en.summary: Mehmet Cemil Acar, a former State Airports Authority department head previously released after authorities found 26 kilograms of gold bars, over 1.3 million dollars, and 121,000 euros in his home, has been detained again in a money laundering investigation.

stories.title: Kurtlar Vadisi'nin 'Ömer Baba'sı Emin Olcay ifade verecek

en.title: Kurtlar Vadisi's 'Ömer Baba' Emin Olcay to Give Statement
en.summary: Emin Olcay, an actor who portrayed the character Ömer Baba in the television series Kurtlar Vadisi, will provide a statement in connection with an investigation into the death of Kaşif Kozinoğlu.

stories.title: 1 ay önce taşınmışlardı: Yaşlı çift evlerinde ölü bulundu

en.title: Elderly couple found dead in their home a month after moving
en.summary: An 80-year-old man and 81-year-old woman were found dead in their home in Bursa, Turkey, one month after relocating to the neighborhood. Police are investigating the incident.

stories.title: DEM Parti'de yeni dönem görev dağılımı belli oldu

en.title: New term duty distribution determined at DEM Party
en.summary: The DEM Party announced new role assignments for its leadership council. Ayşegül Doğan continues in the position of party spokesperson.

stories.title: Antrenmanda sakatlanmıştı: Fenerbahçe'de Mert Müldür gelişmesi!

en.title: Fenerbahçe development regarding Mert Müldür, injured during training
en.summary: Fenerbahçe released a statement about the health status of 27-year-old national team player Mert Müldür following an injury sustained during training.

stories.title: Fenerbahçe’de Mert Müldür şoku! Avusturya’da operasyon geçirdi

en.title: Shock at Fenerbahçe! Mert Müldür underwent surgery in Austria
en.summary: Fenerbahçe announced that Mert Müldür underwent surgery in Austria for a torn left knee meniscus.

stories.title: DEM Parti MYK üyelerinin görevleri belli oldu

en.title: DEM Party MYK members' duties determined
en.summary: The DEM Party's Management Council met under the leadership of Co-Chairs Tülay Hatimoğulları and Tuncer Bakırhan to assign roles for the new term. Most continuing members retained their positions with minimal changes.

stories.title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında bir tutuklama daha

en.title: Another detention in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation
en.summary: A new arrest has been made in the investigation into the 2011 death of former intelligence official Kaşif Kozinoğlu at Silivri Prison.

stories.title: Son Dakika... Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: 1 tutuklama, 2 adli kontrol kararı!

en.title: New development in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation: 1 detention, 2 judicial control orders
en.summary: Former journalist Osman Arslan was arrested in the investigation into former intelligence officer Kaşif Kozinoğlu's prison death. Two others received travel bans as judicial control measures.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA I Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: Osman Arslan tutuklandı

en.title: Breaking news: New development in Kozinoğlu investigation - Osman Arslan arrested
en.summary: A person was arrested after being brought to court in connection with the Silivri Chief Public Prosecutor's investigation into Kaşif Kozinoğlu's death.

en.title: Foundation heritage coded in hackathon
en.summary: A hackathon called 'KÖK and KOD' will be organized by software schools of the Foundation Participation and Information Valley in collaboration with 42 Turkey to make foundation works accessible to wider audiences through digital solutions.

en.title: Istanbul Stock Exchange closes day with gains
en.summary: The BIST 100 index on Istanbul Stock Exchange gained 0.40 percent, finishing at 13,337.69 points.

stories.title: Yasa dışı 420 internet sitesi erişime engellendi

en.title: Access to 420 illegal websites blocked
en.summary: Ankara Provincial Gendarmerie Command blocked access to 420 websites containing illegal gambling, fraud, and obscene content during virtual patrol operations.

stories.title: AKOM uyardı: İstanbul'da şiddetli yağış bekleniyor

en.title: AKOM warns: Heavy rain expected in Istanbul
en.summary: Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality's Disaster Coordination Center announced that heavy rainfall is expected in the city starting tomorrow.

stories.title: Hazine alacakları ağustos sonunda 256,2 milyar lira oldu

en.title: Treasury receivables reached 256.2 billion lira by end of August
en.summary: Treasury receivables totaled 256.2 billion lira as of the end of August.
